details.text: The site self-hosts Latin WOFF2 variable-font subsets through Fontsource npm packages. Every face uses `font-display: swap`; fallback stacks remain in `src/client/src/styles/_tokens.scss`. The packages retain their licence files and attribution metadata in `node_modules`, and the exact resolved versions are locked in `src/client/package-lock.json`.

items: Source and attribution: Google Fonts / Adobe, `github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans`.
Use and fallback: shared site voice; Segoe UI, Arial, then generic sans-serif.
Source and attribution: Google Fonts; metadata attribution is Google Inc.
Use and fallback: body and long-form reading; Iowan Old Style then generic serif.
Source and attribution: Google Fonts / Adobe, `github.com/adobe-fonts/source-code-pro`.
Use and fallback: code, diffs, technical evidence and compact utility text; Cascadia Code, SFMono-Regular, then generic monospace.
